description: Neuralese direct v1 (owner 2026-10-11; plans/neuralese/NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md): plain whole-trajectory target SFT of a base model on the native records, one pass on ordinary token embeddings (no input map, no second pass, no self-distillation), the NeuraleseProjection producing the Neuralese value (soft-token mixture plus a zero-initialised causal conv correction, trained on detached states), the TokenChoiceProjection declared off. Windows hold the whole preceding document (system prompt included); routers and norms on AdamW, attention and expert matrices on the latent optimizer. Shared by both lines; backbone-inherent differences in neuralese-direct-mellum-v1 / -lfm-v1. Qualification: the step-0 identity, held CE below base, no drift stop and the behaviour gate; the value metric and value_margin are report-only (owner 2026-10-11: the value requirement belongs to the end-to-end stage). Eval and checkpoint at the stage end only (with step 0): about 3 h of updates per point at the measured 5.5 s/update exceeds the 1000-step stage, and a gated eval costs about 190 s. The drift monitor (16 held rows, its guard, the gate at a warn) also runs every drift_every (100) updates between evals.
